review.method: Contractor assistant visually inspected all ten fixed RGB checkpoint tiles before any new M3J model inference, correcting projected boxes to visible target extents without detector predictions.
review.scope: Selected target-checkpoints only; not exhaustive labels or independent human certification. Dark, small, crowded, partly occluded and sensor-truncated targets retained where a distinct visible extent can be assigned. Source Cyclist is vehicle family: its box covers visible rider/bicycle aggregate; person boxes cover the visible person. Physical approach labels unchanged. Parked objects approached by the ego camera remain positive relative-approach references.

omissions.boreas-m3j-following-17.6: The projected distant vehicle falls behind the foreground SUV; no reliable independent visible extent can be assigned in the review tile. Original negative candidate retained in candidates.json, not counted as successful abstention.

review.selection: Two source intervals fixed from pose/cadence metadata before RGB inspection; disjoint from M3C-I but adjacent within the same recording, not cross-domain. No candidate removed or relabelled after inference.
